fingerprint_semantics: SHA-256 over u64be(len(fingerprint_profile)) || exact fingerprint-profile UTF-8 bytes || u64be(len(canonical_descriptor)) || the exact minified encoding/json bytes of this map-free ordered descriptor; encode as lowercase hex with the sha256: prefix.
package_closure_semantics: The selected roots are Cutly's exact direct external production imports for the shape-only provider. The strictly sorted external package closure was resolved with CGO_ENABLED=0 and is identical on linux/amd64, windows/amd64, and js/wasm. linked_package_count is the actual selected production-package count for linked modules; module-graph-only requirements have count zero. Any toolchain, target, build-tag, import, or version change must re-resolve and refreeze this closure before release.
sbom_semantics: The deterministic SPDX-2.3 source SBOM records Cutly's current test, linked shape-provider production, and module-graph-only dependencies separately. Package comments mirror closure, reachability, and linked_package_count, while dependency-lock.json is normative. Dependency presence proves supply-chain identity only and does not advertise final Text render capability.
dependency_semantics: This lock records the complete current Cutly Go module graph, binds the exact go.mod and go.sum bytes, and freezes the linked pure-Go shaping package closure and MVS module graph. current_production and current_production_transitive contain packages reachable from the selected provider imports; current_module_graph_only entries have no selected packages. Module sums and origins were resolved through the Go module proxy. Any dependency change must explicitly refreeze both module-file hashes and this descriptor; no version, sum, commit, build tag, or embedded HarfBuzz base may silently drift.
build_binding_semantics: cutly_go_directive is the go directive in this source module, not evidence of the toolchain that built a binary. The dependency fingerprint is platform-independent and covers this complete canonical descriptor. Each ShapeProvider receipt combines this compiled fingerprint with the receipt-exact live LayoutGraph, OutlineSet, and font content hashes; documents, Agents and render requests cannot supply or override it. Executable digest and signing remain release concerns.
license_semantics: Cutly preserves MIT for the current jsonschema-go test import and BSD-3-Clause for its go-cmp module-graph-only upstream test requirement, selects BSD-3-Clause for the dual-licensed go-text modules, preserves BSD-3-Clause plus the upstream PATENTS grant for golang.org/x/image and golang.org/x/text, and preserves the separate MIT notice for the embedded HarfBuzz port. Primary and supplemental notice paths and exact checked-in upstream byte hashes are part of this lock.
capability_semantics: This lock supports a linked, pinned static-glyf ShapeProvider that privately parses the already validated font lineage, executes go-text HarfBuzz shaping, rejects missing glyphs, and normalizes RTL records. It still cannot advertise cutly.text.pinned-font-viewport-px.v2 or prove document assembly, outline rasterization, paint, compositing, encoding, or final backend capability.
excluded_responsibilities: Downloading modules at runtime, resolving floating tags, trusting system fonts, accepting a caller-provided fingerprint, font fallback, document assembly, rasterization, emitting a text surface, signing receipts, and enabling final Text/backend capability are outside this dependency lock.
